description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_AddAutoloadFilters, which provides a method to add autoload filters to a Smarty template engine instance within the Smarty PHP templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AddAutoloadFilters
classes.description: A class extending Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters, providing functionality to add autoload filters to Smarty templates.

methods.name: addAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Adds autoload filters to the Smarty instance, either by merging with existing filters of a specified type or by assigning new filters when type is not specified.
